sentences.en: I can do it if you give me a chance.
sentences.zh: 如果你给我机会，我能做到。

sentences.en: You should avail yourself of the chance to go abroad.
sentences.zh: 你应该抓住出国的机会。

sentences.en: Even if you lose the game, you'll have another chance.
sentences.zh: 即使你输了这场比赛，还有再次的机会。

senses.zh: 机会，际遇；运气，侥幸；可能性
